areas_raw: Broadly speaking, I’m interested in how demographic, inequality, and biological processes combine to influence health and well-being. Much of my research combines genetic information with measures of the social environment to interactively predict health and health behaviors. Another, emerging area of my research addresses the determinants and consequences of extended kinship networks for health and educational attainment. I combine these interests in biology, inequality, and kinship in my research on the causes of racial/ethnic disparities in kidney transplantation.
